verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a reasonable thing to ask of a SaaS identity-verification product, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack shows an assistant inside Stripe Identity or its dashboard to which tasks can be delegated. The Stripe MCP server only provides tools for external AI agents to call the API, which is a developer building block, not a built-in assistant, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
